svg.title: H&E locked-test performance and clean-field burden
svg.desc: Three-panel comparison of positive-field macro Dice, presence AUROC, and clean-field predicted area for seven H&E fold-detection methods.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;
